word-registered-letter.def: a letter sent by post with a receipt that proves it was delivered

word-sender.def: the person who sends a letter or package to someone

word-recipient.def: the person a letter or package is sent to

word-postal-code.def: a group of numbers in an address that shows the mail area

word-courier.def: a person or company that delivers packages and documents

word-tracking-number.def: a number you use to see where your package is on its way

word-pickup-point.def: a place where you go to collect a package that was sent to you

word-mobile-plan.def: an agreement with a phone company for calls, texts and data at a set price

word-prepaid.def: paid for before you use it

word-sim-card.def: a small card in a phone that connects it to a phone network

word-top-up.def: to put more money on a phone so you can keep using it

word-mobile-data.def: internet that your phone uses when it is not connected to Wi-Fi

word-roaming.def: the use of your phone on another company's network, usually in a foreign country

word-phone-signal.def: the radio connection that lets a phone make calls and use the internet

word-voicemail.def: a spoken message that someone leaves on your phone when you do not answer

word-missed-call.def: a phone call that rings but that you do not answer

word-contact-n.def: a person whose name and number you have saved in your phone

word-phone-provider.def: a company that sells phone service and connects your calls

word-router.def: a device that sends the internet signal to computers and phones in a home

word-internet-connection.def: the link that lets a device go online

word-upload.def: to send a file from your device to a website or another computer

word-log-in.def: to enter your name and password to use a website or an app

word-log-out.def: to leave your account on a website or an app

word-username.def: the name you type, with a password, to enter an account

word-email-address.def: the text that identifies a person's mailbox, with an @ sign in the middle

word-attachment.def: a file that you send together with an email message

word-spam.def: unwanted messages, usually advertisements, sent to many people

word-social-network.def: a website or app where people share posts and photos with friends

word-video-call.def: a phone or internet call in which people can also see each other

word-link.def: text or a picture you click to open another web page

word-qr-code.def: a square pattern of black and white dots that a phone camera can scan

word-notification.def: a short message that appears on your phone to tell you something new

word-landline.def: a telephone that is connected by wires, not by a mobile network

word-postal-worker.def: a person whose job is to bring letters and packages to homes

word-eircode-ie.gl: Eircode: Irish seven-character postcode that identifies each individual address
